cc:Work.dc:description: Illustrative optimistic start-to-start reference with gas conditioning time set to zero. Impulsive thermal limit is 34.522 s. Defined gas recovery path: 3 s pulse, then condition residual gas to 300 K, then refill isothermally from 10 to 30 MPa. At 20 kW the refill takes 347.916 s; the conditional period is 350.916 s plus unknown conditioning time. The greater thermal/gas bound applies only with independent parallel resources; no vehicle readiness is proven.
